about: The 20 steps every idea goes through, in order; an idea stops at the first failed gate. 'agent' is the role file in .claude/agents/, 'orchestrator' is the main Opus session. The dashboard (python tools/dashboard.py) reads this file.

steps.name: Set the measure
steps.detail: P(5x in a month) = N(N^-1(0.2) + Sharpe sqrt(1/12)) for Hydra; first-payout time and failure rate for Funded

steps.name: Find ideas
steps.detail: Papers and concepts, checked against the rejected list in docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/candidates.json; up to 5 a week

steps.name: Read the full paper
steps.detail: Definitions, tables, costs, sample; no testing from an abstract

steps.name: Get the data
steps.detail: tools/ downloaders into marketdata/

steps.name: Check the data
steps.detail: Time zone, 23:00-01:00 rollover quotes, gaps, duplicates

steps.name: Prototype
steps.detail: research/<idea>.py; for ML: replicate the paper, purge and embargo, several seeds, simple baselines

steps.name: Real costs, then 1.5-2x
steps.detail: Measured spreads and fills; writes marketdata/candidates/<id>.csv and <id>_stress.csv

steps.name: Out of sample
steps.detail: Settings fitted to 2017, judged from 2018; shifted windows, every year, random-entry baseline

steps.name: Deflated Sharpe
steps.detail: Every trial counted (docs/trials.jsonl + 47 before the log)

steps.name: Correlation and book Sharpe
steps.detail: Against the Hydra book and each leg; weight fitted to 2017

steps.name: Goal simulation
steps.detail: Hydra's P(5x) and the prop simulators (tools/backtest_prop.py, prop_candidates.py)

steps.name: Standalone MQL5 EA
steps.detail: Broker stops, unique magic, state that survives a restart, server-clock check

steps.name: Compile 0/0
steps.detail: metaeditor64 /compile: 0 errors, 0 warnings

steps.name: Merge into Hydra and Funded
steps.detail: Off by default, through SizeMult() and the prop guards

steps.name: Strategy Tester
steps.detail: Real ticks from 2024-01 on FTMO's data; must match the Python figures

steps.name: Leg on vs off in the main EA
steps.detail: Return per drawdown must rise; no day stop in Funded

steps.name: Demo forward test 2-4 weeks
steps.detail: FTMO demo terminal; daily check-ins in docs/demo_log.md, weekly review

steps.name: Recheck firm rules, pick preset
steps.detail: The firm's own pages on the day

steps.name: Buy or go live
steps.detail: The owner only

steps.name: Monitor, handoff, push
steps.detail: Daily check-ins; docs/HANDOFF.md; commit and push
